nodes.label: SCHOBRAS Isotipo (brand mark)
nodes.rationale: Symbol-only brand mark (no wordmark) for SCHOBRAS.CL / Constructora Schonffeldt SpA; a flat monochrome pictogram of a building in progress, usable at small sizes (favicon, header).

nodes.label: Stepped Building Silhouette
nodes.rationale: Two solid dark blocks of different heights (tall left tower, lower right volume) separated by a narrow gap, read as a building/skyline; represents the finished architecture.

nodes.label: Rebar / Scaffolding Vertical Lines
nodes.rationale: Thin vertical lines rising from the left side and above the tall block, like exposed rebar or scaffolding; signals construction in progress.

nodes.label: Ground Baseline
nodes.rationale: Horizontal line anchoring the composition, reading as the terrain/foundation level.

nodes.label: Monochrome Charcoal Palette
nodes.rationale: Single dark-gray/charcoal ink on white; sober, industrial tone and easy reproduction in one color.

nodes.label: Architecture + Construction Duality
nodes.rationale: The mark pairs a finished solid volume (architecture/design) with exposed rebar/scaffold lines (construction/execution), mirroring the company's combined architecture + construction offering.

nodes.label: Possible Letterform in Negative Space
nodes.rationale: The two blocks with the gap between them may read as a lowercase 'h' or 'n'; uncertain whether intentional (e.g. tied to the Schonffeldt/Schobras name). Flag for review.
